If it's convenient, I can send a proposed sideletter redline by EOD.

Thanks,

Soojin — thanks, this is helpful. We reviewed the numbers and the proposed term shift; attaching our sideletter with a few tracked changes and a short comment on termination language. Main asks from our side:

- Limit the automatic fallback to a 30-day notice rather than immediate stepdown on capacity.
- Add a 12-month price protection clause for any model-variant uplifts tied to major version releases.
- Clarify data residency for log retention (we prefer EU region for PHI-derived telemetry).

I've attached Kestrel_MSA_sideletter_draft_20260929.docx with comments. We'd like Redwood to propose a compromise on the termination/fallback language because our procurement team is nervous about mid-quarter capacity cuts.

On the Order Form — quantities look good but please confirm effective dates after the term alignment proration.

Best,

Team — forwarding Kestrel's tracked sideletter (attached) and flagging the three asks Alex called out. Can Legal weigh in on our negotiation posture? My suggested positions:

- Termination / capacity stepdown: counter-propose a 60-day notice with a 30-day immediate temporary cap (not removal of baseline) and a 30-day remediation window.
- Price-protection on major model upgrades: accept but limit to two major-version protections per 12-month period and require 30-day notice for any material price impact.
- Data residency for retention logs: we can offer EU log storage but need to confirm cost impact. Suggest we ask Kestrel for specific retention window (e.g., 90 days) before agreeing.

I will draft a consolidated redline from Redwood and send to Alex by tomorrow morning. Please call out any absolute non-starters — Marissa, ADT (Aditya), can you highlight any commercial redlines that need escalation?

Thanks —
Soojin

Alex — thanks for the quick review and the draft. Attached is our consolidated redline: MSA_sideletter_redlines_Redwood_20261001.docx. Summary of our positions:

- Capacity stepdown: We can accept a 60-day notice with a 30-day temporary cap + 30-day remediation window (see para 3).
- Price protection: We agree to one 12-month price-protection event tied to major model-version releases. Any further protections to be separately negotiated, not automatic.
- Data residency: We will provide EU log storage for telemetry related to PHI-derived flows at an incremental fee; please confirm retention duration and whether Kestrel requires long-term archives.

Two operational asks before we finalize:
1) Please confirm the effective date for the proration so we can populate the Order Form.
2) Approve the DocuSign envelope I just created for the OrderForm_Kestrel_v2.pdf so billing can start after signature: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=XYZ-OrderForm-KST-2026-04

If all good, we're aiming to have fully executed paperwork by Oct 7 to meet your internal renewal cutoff.

Regards,

Marissa Cole
